006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.model;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.CollectionUtil;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
011
012import java.util.Collection;
013
014import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
016
017/**
018 * This behavioral interface represents an instance that supports grouped
019 * values.
020 */
021public interface IGroupable extends IInstance {
022
023  /**
024   * The default Metaschema grouping minimum occurrence.
025   */
026  int DEFAULT_GROUP_AS_MIN_OCCURS = 0;
027  /**
028   * The default Metaschema grouping maximum occurrence.
029   */
030  int DEFAULT_GROUP_AS_MAX_OCCURS = 1;
031  /**
032   * The default Metaschema grouping behavior for JSON data.
033   */
034  @NonNull
035  JsonGroupAsBehavior DEFAULT_JSON_GROUP_AS_BEHAVIOR = JsonGroupAsBehavior.SINGLETON_OR_LIST;
036  /**
037   * The default Metaschema grouping behavior for XML data.
038   */
039  @NonNull
040  XmlGroupAsBehavior DEFAULT_XML_GROUP_AS_BEHAVIOR = XmlGroupAsBehavior.UNGROUPED;
041
042  /**
043   * Get the minimum cardinality for this associated instance. This value must be
044   * less than or equal to the maximum cardinality returned by
045   * {@link #getMaxOccurs()}.
046   *
047   * @return {@code 0} or a positive integer value
048   * @see #DEFAULT_GROUP_AS_MIN_OCCURS
049   */
050  int getMinOccurs();
051
052  /**
053   * Get the maximum cardinality for this associated instance. This value must be
054   * greater than or equal to the minimum cardinality returned by
055   * {@link #getMinOccurs()}, or {@code -1} if unbounded.
056   *
057   * @return a positive integer value or {@code -1} if unbounded
058   * @see #DEFAULT_GROUP_AS_MAX_OCCURS
059   */
060  int getMaxOccurs();
061
062  /**
063   * Get the name provided for grouping. An instance in Metaschema must have a
064   * group name if the instance has a cardinality greater than {@code 1}.
065   *
066   * @return the group-as name or {@code null} if no name is configured, such as
067   *         when {@link #getMaxOccurs()} = 1
068   */
069  @Nullable
070  default String getGroupAsName() {
071    // no group-as by default
072    return null;
073  }
074
075  /**
076   * Get the name used for the associated element wrapping a collection of
077   * elements in XML. This value is required when {@link #getXmlGroupAsBehavior()}
078   * = {@link XmlGroupAsBehavior#GROUPED}. This name will be the element name
079   * wrapping a collection of elements.
080   * <p>
081   * If this instance doesn't have a namespace defined, then the module's XML
082   * namespace will be used.
083   *
084   * @return the groupAs QName or {@code null} if no name is configured, such as
085   *         when {@link #getMaxOccurs()} = 1.
086   */
087  @Nullable
088  default IEnhancedQName getEffectiveXmlGroupAsQName() {
089    return getXmlGroupAsBehavior() == XmlGroupAsBehavior.GROUPED
090        ? IEnhancedQName.of(
091            getContainingDefinition().getQName().getNamespace(),
092            ObjectUtils.requireNonNull(getGroupAsName()))
093        : null;
094  }
095
096  /**
097   * Gets the configured JSON group-as strategy. A JSON group-as strategy is only
098   * required when {@link #getMaxOccurs()} &gt; 1.
099   * <p>
100   * The default for this method is {@link JsonGroupAsBehavior#NONE}, since the
101   * default behavior is to have no grouping. If {@link #getMaxOccurs()} is
102   * greater than {@code 1}, then the default behavior is
103   * {@code #DEFAULT_JSON_GROUP_AS_BEHAVIOR}.
104   *
105   * @return the JSON group-as strategy, or {@code JsonGroupAsBehavior#NONE} if
106   *         {@link #getMaxOccurs()} = 1
107   * @see #DEFAULT_JSON_GROUP_AS_BEHAVIOR
108   */
109  @NonNull
110  default JsonGroupAsBehavior getJsonGroupAsBehavior() {
111    return JsonGroupAsBehavior.NONE;
112  }
113
114  /**
115   * Gets the configured XML group-as strategy. A XML group-as strategy is only
116   * required when {@link #getMaxOccurs()} &gt; 1.
117   *
118   * @return the JSON group-as strategy, or {@code XmlGroupAsBehavior#UNGROUPED}
119   *         if {@link #getMaxOccurs()} = 1
120   * @see #DEFAULT_XML_GROUP_AS_BEHAVIOR
121   */
122  @NonNull
123  default XmlGroupAsBehavior getXmlGroupAsBehavior() {
124    return DEFAULT_XML_GROUP_AS_BEHAVIOR;
125  }
126
127  /**
128   * Get the item values for the provided {@code instanceValue}. An instance may
129   * be singular or many valued.
130   *
131   * @param instanceValue
132   *          the instance
133   * @return the item values or an empty collection if no item values exist
134   */
135  @NonNull
136  default Collection<?> getItemValues(@NonNull Object instanceValue) {
137    // no item values by default
138    return CollectionUtil.emptyList();
139  }
140}
